au.bas.quarterlyDueDates.note: Registered agents may get later dates; a weekend or public holiday moves the date to the next business day.

au.super.maxContributionBaseAnnual.label: Maximum contribution base (annual, 2026–27)

au.super.paydaySuperStart.label: Payday Super starts
au.super.paydaySuperStart.note: Super is due with each payday and must reach the fund within 7 business days. The Small Business Superannuation Clearing House closed on 1 July 2026.

au.super.paydayDeadlineBusinessDays.label: Payday Super: business days for contributions to reach the fund

au.depreciation.instantAssetWriteOff.label: Instant asset write-off limit (per asset, turnover under $10m)

uk.vat.returnDeadline.label: VAT return and payment deadline
uk.vat.returnDeadline.value: 1 calendar month and 7 days after the end of the VAT period
uk.vat.returnDeadline.note: Example: quarter ending 31 March is due 7 May. Late returns earn penalty points (periods from 1 January 2023).

uk.mtd.itsaStart.label: MTD for Income Tax: first group (qualifying income over £50,000)

uk.vat.returnDueMonthsAfter.label: VAT return: months after period end it is due
uk.vat.returnDueMonthsAfter.note: GOV.UK: the return deadline is "one calendar month and 7 days after the end of an accounting period". Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.vat.returnDueExtraDays.label: VAT return: days added after those months
uk.vat.returnDueExtraDays.note: GOV.UK: the return deadline is "one calendar month and 7 days after the end of an accounting period". Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ct.paymentDueMonthsAfter.label: Corporation Tax payment: months after period end it is due
uk.ct.paymentDueMonthsAfter.note: GOV.UK: "You must pay your Corporation Tax 9 months and 1 day after the end of your accounting period" (companies with profits up to 1.5 million pounds). Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ct.paymentDueExtraDays.label: Corporation Tax payment: days added after those months
uk.ct.paymentDueExtraDays.note: GOV.UK: "You must pay your Corporation Tax 9 months and 1 day after the end of your accounting period". Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ct.returnDueMonthsAfter.label: Company Tax Return (CT600): months after period end it is due
uk.ct.returnDueMonthsAfter.note: GOV.UK: "The deadline for your tax return is 12 months after the end of the accounting period it covers." Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ch.accountsDueMonthsAfter.label: Companies House accounts: months after the accounting reference date they are due
uk.ch.accountsDueMonthsAfter.note: GOV.UK: later accounts are due "9 months after your company's financial year ends". Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ch.firstAccountsDueMonthsAfterIncorpo.label: Companies House first accounts: months after incorporation they are due
uk.ch.firstAccountsDueMonthsAfterIncorpo.note: GOV.UK: first accounts are due "21 months after the date you registered with Companies House". Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ch.firstPeriodMinMonths.label: Companies House first accounting period: it must be more than this many months
uk.ch.firstPeriodMinMonths.note: Companies Act 2006 s.391(5): "A company's first accounting reference period is the period of more than six months, but not more than 18 months" beginning with incorporation. Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.ch.confirmationDueDaysAfter.label: Confirmation statement: days after the review period ends it is due
uk.ch.confirmationDueDaysAfter.note: GOV.UK: "You can file your statement up to 14 days after the review period has ended." Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.sa.onlineDueMonth.label: Self Assessment online return: month it is due
uk.sa.onlineDueMonth.note: GOV.UK: the online return and payment are due by 11:59pm on 31 January after the tax year ends (31 January 2027 for 2025 to 2026). Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.sa.onlineDueDay.label: Self Assessment online return: day it is due
uk.sa.onlineDueDay.note: GOV.UK: the online return and payment are due by 11:59pm on 31 January after the tax year ends (31 January 2027 for 2025 to 2026). Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.sa.secondPaymentOnAccountMonth.label: Second payment on account: month it is due
uk.sa.secondPaymentOnAccountMonth.note: GOV.UK: "These payments are due by midnight on 31 January and 31 July." Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.sa.secondPaymentOnAccountDay.label: Second payment on account: day it is due
uk.sa.secondPaymentOnAccountDay.note: GOV.UK: "These payments are due by midnight on 31 January and 31 July." Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.mtdItsa.updateDueMonthsAfter.label: MTD Income Tax quarterly update: months after the update period ends it is due
uk.mtdItsa.updateDueMonthsAfter.note: GOV.UK lists update deadlines of 7 August, 7 November, 7 February and 7 May, for standard periods ending 5 July, 5 October, 5 January and 5 April. Effective date not stated on the source page.

uk.mtdItsa.updateDueDay.label: MTD Income Tax quarterly update: day of that month it is due
